title: Widgets
description: Reference for the visible overlays that stay attached to the Studio scene or export board.

ui.overview: Widgets are the live overlays that sit on top of the scene or the export board. They show context, status, or summary data while the map stays visible underneath.

controls.label: Compass
controls.description: Shows heading and orientation so you can confirm how the scene is turned.

controls.label: Credits
controls.description: Shows map and source credits. Keep it visible when the output must keep attribution in frame.

controls.label: Elevation Profile
controls.description: Shows the route elevation shape and helps you check profile readability in the capture area.

controls.label: Text
controls.description: Adds a custom label, note, or callout to the scene or journey board.

controls.label: Journey Stats
controls.description: Shows distance, elevation, duration, and summary data for the active journey.

notes: Widgets can be moved, resized, rotated, or hidden depending on their capabilities.
Use the widget editor drawer when you need to change the configuration of a selected widget.
Check the final capture size, not just the editing zoom, before exporting.
